verses.original: מִ֭שְׁלֵי שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בֶן־ דָּוִ֑ד מֶ֝֗לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: miš·lê šə·lō·mōh ḇen- dā·wiḏ me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: These are the proverbs of Solomon son of David king of Israel
verses.literalPt: PROVÉRBIOS de Salomão, filho de Davi, rei de Israel;

verses.original: לָדַ֣עַת חָכְמָ֣ה וּמוּסָ֑ר לְ֝הָבִ֗ין אִמְרֵ֥י בִינָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḏa·‘aṯ ḥāḵ·māh ū·mū·sār lə·hā·ḇîn ’im·rê ḇî·nāh
verses.literal: for gaining wisdom and discipline for comprehending words of insight
verses.literalPt: Para se conhecer a sabedoria e a instrução; para se entenderem, as palavras da prudência.

verses.original: לָ֭קַחַת מוּסַ֣ר הַשְׂכֵּ֑ל צֶ֥דֶק וּ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט וּמֵישָׁרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: lā·qa·ḥaṯ mū·sar haś·kêl ṣe·ḏeq ū·miš·pāṭ ū·mê·šā·rîm
verses.literal: and for receiving instruction in wise living and in righteousness justice and equity
verses.literalPt: Para se receber a instrução do entendimento, a justiça, o juízo e a eqüidade;

verses.original: לָתֵ֣ת לִפְתָאיִ֣ם עָרְמָ֑ה לְ֝נַ֗עַר דַּ֣עַת וּמְזִמָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ṯêṯ lip̄·ṯā·yim ‘ā·rə·māh lə·na·‘ar da·‘aṯ ū·mə·zim·māh
verses.literal: To impart prudence to the simple and knowledge and discretion to the young
verses.literalPt: Para dar aos simples, prudência, e aos moços, conhecimento e bom siso;

verses.original: יִשְׁמַ֣ע חָ֭כָם וְי֣וֹסֶף לֶ֑קַח וְ֝נָב֗וֹן תַּחְבֻּל֥וֹת יִקְנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: yiš·ma‘ ḥā·ḵām wə·yō·w·sep̄ le·qaḥ wə·nā·ḇō·wn taḥ·bu·lō·wṯ yiq·neh
verses.literal: let the wise listen and gain instruction and the discerning acquire wise counsel
verses.literalPt: O sábio ouvirá e crescerá em conhecimento, e o entendido adquirirá sábios conselhos;

verses.original: לְהָבִ֣ין מָ֭שָׁל וּמְלִיצָ֑ה דִּבְרֵ֥י חֲ֝כָמִ֗ים וְחִידֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lə·hā·ḇîn mā·šāl ū·mə·lî·ṣāh diḇ·rê ḥă·ḵā·mîm wə·ḥî·ḏō·ṯām
verses.literal: by understanding the proverbs and parables the sayings and riddles of the wise
verses.literalPt: Para entender os provérbios e sua interpretação; as palavras dos sábios e as suas proposições.

verses.original: יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה רֵאשִׁ֣ית דָּ֑עַת חָכְמָ֥ה וּ֝מוּסָ֗ר אֱוִילִ֥ים בָּֽזוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: yir·’aṯ Yah·weh rê·šîṯ dā·‘aṯ ḥāḵ·māh ū·mū·sār ’ĕ·wî·lîm bā·zū
verses.literal: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge but fools despise wisdom and discipline
verses.literalPt: O temor do SENHOR é o princípio do conhecimento; os loucos desprezam a sabedoria e a instrução.

verses.original: שְׁמַ֣ע בְּ֭נִי מוּסַ֣ר אָבִ֑יךָ וְאַל־ תִּ֝טֹּ֗שׁ תּוֹרַ֥ת אִמֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: šə·ma‘ bə·nî mū·sar ’ā·ḇî·ḵā wə·’al- tiṭ·ṭōš tō·w·raṯ ’im·me·ḵā
verses.literal: Listen my son to your father’s instruction and do not forsake . . . the teaching of your mother
verses.literalPt: Filho meu, ouve a instrução de teu pai, e não deixes o ensinamento de tua mãe,

verses.original: כִּ֤י׀ לִוְיַ֤ת חֵ֓ן הֵ֬ם לְרֹאשֶׁ֑ךָ וַ֝עֲנָקִ֗ים לְגַרְגְּרֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî liw·yaṯ ḥên hêm lə·rō·še·ḵā wa·‘ă·nā·qîm lə·ḡar·gə·rō·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: For they are a garland of grace on your head and a pendant around your neck
verses.literalPt: Porque serão como diadema gracioso em tua cabeça, e colares ao teu pescoço.

verses.original: בְּנִ֡י אִם־ יְפַתּ֥וּךָ חַ֝טָּאִ֗ים אַל־ תֹּבֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nî ’im- yə·p̄at·tū·ḵā ḥaṭ·ṭā·’îm ’al- tō·ḇê
verses.literal: My son if sinners entice you do not yield to them
verses.literalPt: Filho meu, se os pecadores procuram te atrair com agrados, não aceites.

verses.original: אִם־ יֹאמְרוּ֮ לְכָ֪ה אִ֫תָּ֥נוּ נֶאֶרְבָ֥ה לְדָ֑ם נִצְפְּנָ֖ה לְנָקִ֣י חִנָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- yō·mə·rū lə·ḵāh ’it·tā·nū ne·’er·ḇāh lə·ḏām niṣ·pə·nāh lə·nā·qî ḥin·nām
verses.literal: If they say Come along let us lie in wait for blood let us ambush the innocent without cause
verses.literalPt: Se disserem: Vem conosco a tocaias de sangue; embosquemos o inocente sem motivo;

verses.original: נִ֭בְלָעֵם כִּשְׁא֣וֹל חַיִּ֑ים וּ֝תְמִימִ֗ים כְּי֣וֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: niḇ·lā·‘êm kiš·’ō·wl ḥay·yîm ū·ṯə·mî·mîm kə·yō·wr·ḏê ḇō·wr
verses.literal: let us swallow them alive like Sheol and whole like those descending into the Pit
verses.literalPt: Traguemo-los vivos, como a sepultura; e inteiros, como os que descem à cova;

verses.original: כָּל־ ה֣וֹן יָקָ֣ר נִמְצָ֑א נְמַלֵּ֖א בָתֵּ֣ינוּ שָׁלָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- hō·wn yā·qār nim·ṣā nə·mal·lê ḇāt·tê·nū šā·lāl
verses.literal: We will find all manner of precious goods we will fill our houses with plunder
verses.literalPt: Acharemos toda sorte de bens preciosos; encheremos as nossas casas de despojos;

verses.original: גּ֭וֹרָ֣לְךָ תַּפִּ֣יל בְּתוֹכֵ֑נוּ כִּ֥יס אֶ֝חָ֗ד יִהְיֶ֥ה לְכֻלָּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: gō·w·rā·lə·ḵā tap·pîl bə·ṯō·w·ḵê·nū kîs ’e·ḥāḏ yih·yeh lə·ḵul·lā·nū
verses.literal: Throw in your lot with us let us all share one purse
verses.literalPt: Lança a tua sorte conosco; teremos todos uma só bolsa!

verses.original: בְּנִ֗י אַל־ תֵּלֵ֣ךְ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ אִתָּ֑ם מְנַ֥ע רַ֝גְלְךָ֗ מִנְּתִיבָתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nî ’al- tê·lêḵ bə·ḏe·reḵ ’it·tām mə·na‘ raḡ·lə·ḵā min·nə·ṯî·ḇā·ṯām
verses.literal: my son do not walk the road with them or set foot upon their path
verses.literalPt: Filho meu, não te ponhas a caminho com eles; desvia o teu pé das suas veredas;

verses.original: כִּ֣י רַ֭גְלֵיהֶם לָרַ֣ע יָר֑וּצוּ וִֽ֝ימַהֲר֗וּ לִשְׁפָּךְ־ דָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî raḡ·lê·hem lā·ra‘ yā·rū·ṣū wî·ma·hă·rū liš·pāḵ- dām
verses.literal: For their feet run to evil and they are swift to shed blood
verses.literalPt: Porque os seus pés correm para o mal, e se apressam a derramar sangue.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ חִ֭נָּם מְזֹרָ֣ה הָרָ֑שֶׁת בְּ֝עֵינֵ֗י כָל־ בַּ֥עַל כָּנָֽף׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḥin·nām mə·zō·rāh hā·rā·šeṯ bə·‘ê·nê ḵāl ba·ʿal kā·nāp̄
verses.literal: How futile it is to spread the net where any bird . . . can see it
verses.literalPt: Na verdade é inútil estender-se a rede ante os olhos de qualquer ave.

verses.original: וְ֭הֵם לְדָמָ֣ם יֶאֱרֹ֑בוּ יִ֝צְפְּנ֗וּ לְנַפְשֹׁתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hêm lə·ḏā·mām ye·’ĕ·rō·ḇū yiṣ·pə·nū lə·nap̄·šō·ṯām
verses.literal: But they lie in wait for their own blood they ambush their own lives
verses.literalPt: No entanto estes armam ciladas contra o seu próprio sangue; e espreitam suas próprias vidas.

verses.original: כֵּ֗ן אָ֭רְחוֹת כָּל־ בֹּ֣צֵֽעַ בָּ֑צַע אֶת־ נֶ֖פֶשׁ בְּעָלָ֣יו יִקָּֽח׃פ
verses.transliteration: kên ’ā·rə·ḥō·wṯ kāl- bō·ṣê·a‘ bā·ṣa‘ ’eṯ- ne·p̄eš bə·‘ā·lāw yiq·qāḥ
verses.literal: Such is the fate of all who are greedy whose unjust gain takes the lives of its possessors
verses.literalPt: São assim as veredas de todo aquele que usa de cobiça: ela põe a perder a alma dos que a possuem.

verses.original: חָ֭כְמוֹת בַּח֣וּץ תָּרֹ֑נָּה בָּ֝רְחֹב֗וֹת תִּתֵּ֥ן קוֹלָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·ḵə·mō·wṯ ba·ḥūṣ tā·rōn·nāh bā·rə·ḥō·ḇō·wṯ tit·tên qō·w·lāh
verses.literal: Wisdom calls out in the street she lifts her voice in the square
verses.literalPt: A sabedoria clama lá fora; pelas ruas levanta a sua voz.

verses.original: בְּרֹ֥אשׁ הֹמִיּ֗וֹת תִּ֫קְרָ֥א בְּפִתְחֵ֖י שְׁעָרִ֥ים בָּעִ֗יר אֲמָרֶ֥יהָ תֹאמֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: bə·rōš hō·mî·yō·wṯ tiq·rā bə·p̄iṯ·ḥê šə·‘ā·rîm bā·‘îr ’ă·mā·re·hā ṯō·mêr
verses.literal: in the main concourse she cries aloud at the city gates she makes her speech
verses.literalPt: Nas esquinas movimentadas ela brada; nas entradas das portas e nas cidades profere as suas palavras:

verses.original: עַד־ מָתַ֣י׀ פְּתָיִם֮ תְּֽאֵהֲב֫וּ פֶ֥תִי וְלֵצִ֗ים לָ֭צוֹן חָמְד֣וּ לָהֶ֑ם וּ֝כְסִילִ֗ים יִשְׂנְאוּ־ דָֽעַת׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ- mā·ṯay pə·ṯā·yim tə·’ê·hă·ḇū p̄e·ṯî wə·lê·ṣîm lā·ṣō·wn ḥā·mə·ḏū lā·hem ū·ḵə·sî·lîm yiś·nə·’ū- ḏā·‘aṯ
verses.literal: How long O simple ones will you love your simple ways How long will scoffers delight . . . in their scorn and fools hate knowledge
verses.literalPt: Até quando, ó simples, amareis a simplicidade? E vós escarnecedores, desejareis o escárnio? E vós insensatos, odiareis o conhecimento?

verses.original: תָּשׁ֗וּבוּ לְֽת֫וֹכַחְתִּ֥י הִנֵּ֤ה אַבִּ֣יעָה לָכֶ֣ם רוּחִ֑י אוֹדִ֖יעָה דְבָרַ֣י אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: tā·šū·ḇū lə·ṯō·w·ḵaḥ·tî hin·nêh ’ab·bî·‘āh lā·ḵem rū·ḥî ’ō·w·ḏî·‘āh ḏə·ḇā·ray ’eṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: If you had repented at my rebuke then surely I would have poured out my spirit on you I would have made my words known to you
verses.literalPt: Atentai para a minha repreensão; pois eis que vos derramarei abundantemente do meu espírito e vos farei saber as minhas palavras.

verses.original: יַ֣עַן קָ֭רָאתִי וַתְּמָאֵ֑נוּ נָטִ֥יתִי יָ֝דִ֗י וְאֵ֣ין מַקְשִֽׁיב׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘an qā·rā·ṯî wat·tə·mā·’ê·nū nā·ṭî·ṯî yā·ḏî wə·’ên maq·šîḇ
verses.literal: Because you refused my call and no one took my outstretched hand
verses.literalPt: Entretanto, porque eu clamei e recusastes; e estendi a minha mão e não houve quem desse atenção,

verses.original: וַתִּפְרְע֥וּ כָל־ עֲצָתִ֑י וְ֝תוֹכַחְתִּ֗י לֹ֣א אֲבִיתֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tip̄·rə·‘ū ḵāl ‘ă·ṣā·ṯî wə·ṯō·w·ḵaḥ·tî lō ’ă·ḇî·ṯem
verses.literal: because you neglected all my counsel and wanted none of my correction
verses.literalPt: Antes rejeitastes todo o meu conselho, e não quisestes a minha repreensão,

verses.original: גַּם־ אֲ֭נִי בְּאֵידְכֶ֣ם אֶשְׂחָ֑ק אֶ֝לְעַ֗ג בְּבֹ֣א פַחְדְּכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: gam- ’ă·nî bə·’ê·ḏə·ḵem ’eś·ḥāq ’el·‘aḡ bə·ḇō p̄aḥ·də·ḵem
verses.literal: in turn I will mock your calamity I will sneer when terror strikes you
verses.literalPt: Também de minha parte eu me rirei na vossa perdição e zombarei, em vindo o vosso temor.

verses.original: בְּבֹ֤א כְשַׁאֲוָה פַּחְדְּכֶ֗ם וְֽ֭אֵידְכֶם כְּסוּפָ֣ה יֶאֱתֶ֑ה בְּבֹ֥א עֲ֝לֵיכֶ֗ם צָרָ֥ה וְצוּקָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḇō ḵə·ša·ʾă·wå̄h paḥ·də·ḵem wə·’ê·ḏə·ḵem kə·sū·p̄āh ye·’ĕ·ṯeh bə·ḇō ‘ă·lê·ḵem ṣā·rāh wə·ṣū·qāh
verses.literal: when your dread comes like a storm and your destruction like a whirlwind when distress and anguish overwhelm you . . .
verses.literalPt: Vindo o vosso temor como a assolação, e vindo a vossa perdição como uma tormenta, sobrevirá a vós aperto e angústia.

verses.original: אָ֣ז יִ֭קְרָאֻנְנִי וְלֹ֣א אֶֽעֱנֶ֑ה יְ֝שַׁחֲרֻ֗נְנִי וְלֹ֣א יִמְצָאֻֽנְנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz yiq·rā·’un·nî wə·lō ’e·‘ĕ·neh yə·ša·ḥă·run·nî wə·lō yim·ṣā·’un·nî
verses.literal: Then they will call on me but I will not answer they will earnestly seek me but will not find me
verses.literalPt: Então clamarão a mim, mas eu não responderei; de madrugada me buscarão, porém não me acharão.

verses.original: תַּ֭חַת כִּי־ שָׂ֣נְאוּ דָ֑עַת וְיִרְאַ֥ת יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה לֹ֣א בָחָֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ta·ḥaṯ kî- śā·nə·’ū ḏā·‘aṯ wə·yir·’aṯ Yah·weh lō ḇā·ḥā·rū
verses.literal: For they hated knowledge and chose not to fear the LORD
verses.literalPt: Porquanto odiaram o conhecimento; e não preferiram o temor do SENHOR:

verses.original: לֹא־ אָב֥וּ לַעֲצָתִ֑י נָ֝אֲצ֗וּ כָּל־ תּוֹכַחְתִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ’ā·ḇū la·‘ă·ṣā·ṯî nā·’ă·ṣū kāl- tō·w·ḵaḥ·tî
verses.literal: They accepted none of my counsel they despised all my reproof
verses.literalPt: Não aceitaram o meu conselho, e desprezaram toda a minha repreensão.

verses.original: וְֽ֭יֹאכְלוּ מִפְּרִ֣י דַרְכָּ֑ם וּֽמִמֹּעֲצֹ֖תֵיהֶ֣ם יִשְׂבָּֽעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yō·ḵə·lū mip·pə·rî ḏar·kām ū·mim·mō·‘ă·ṣō·ṯê·hem yiś·bā·‘ū
verses.literal: So they will eat the fruit of their own way and be filled with their own devices
verses.literalPt: Portanto comerão do fruto do seu caminho, e fartar-se-ão dos seus próprios conselhos.

verses.original: כִּ֤י מְשׁוּבַ֣ת פְּתָיִ֣ם תַּֽהַרְגֵ֑ם וְשַׁלְוַ֖ת כְּסִילִ֣ים תְּאַבְּדֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî mə·šū·ḇaṯ pə·ṯā·yim ta·har·ḡêm wə·šal·waṯ kə·sî·lîm tə·’ab·bə·ḏêm
verses.literal: For the waywardness of the simple will slay them and the complacency of fools will destroy them
verses.literalPt: Porque o erro dos simples os matará, e o desvario dos insensatos os destruirá.

verses.original: וְשֹׁמֵ֣עַֽ לִ֭י יִשְׁכָּן־ בֶּ֑טַח וְ֝שַׁאֲנַ֗ן מִפַּ֥חַד רָעָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·šō·mê·a‘ lî yiš·kān- be·ṭaḥ wə·ša·’ă·nan mip·pa·ḥaḏ rā·‘āh
verses.literal: But whoever listens to me will dwell in safety secure from the fear of evil
verses.literalPt: Mas o que me der ouvidos habitará em segurança, e estará livre do temor do mal.
